Contrarius Investment Management LTD Has Increased American Eagle Outfitters Ne (AEO) Stake; Macquarie Infrastructure Co (MIC) Sentiment Is 1.24 
April 22, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy 
Macquarie Infrastructure Co LLC (MIC) investors sentiment decreased to 1.24 in 2017 Q4 . It’s down -0.22, from 1.46 in 2017Q3. The ratio is negative, as 178 active investment managers started new and increased holdings, while 143 reduced and sold their stakes in Macquarie Infrastructure Co LLC. The active investment managers in our database now have: 64.11 million shares, up from 63.11 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of active investment managers holding Macquarie Infrastructure Co LLC in top ten holdings increased from 10 to 13 for an increase of 3. Sold All: 40 Reduced: 103 Increased: 125 New Position: 53. 
Contrarius Investment Management Ltd increased American Eagle Outfitters Ne (AEO) stake by 33.71% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Contrarius Investment Management Ltd acquired 296,920 shares as American Eagle Outfitters Ne (AEO)’s stock rose 3.61%. The Contrarius Investment Management Ltd holds 1.18M shares with $22.14 million value, up from 880,887 last quarter. American Eagle Outfitters Ne now has $3.67 billion valuation. The stock decreased 2.87% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $20.68. About 4.96M shares traded or 22.21% up from the average. American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) has risen 39.60% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.05% the S&P500. 
Among 29 analysts covering American Eagle Outfitters ( NYSE:AEO ), 15 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 52% are positive. American Eagle Outfitters had 96 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Telsey Advisory Group given on Thursday, December 7. The rating was maintained by FBR Capital with “Buy” on Friday, December 15. FBR Capital maintained American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) on Thursday, December 1 with “Mkt Perform” rating. On Wednesday, December 6 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. The stock of American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) earned “Neutral” rating by Buckingham Research on Wednesday, January 25. The rating was maintained by JP Morgan on Thursday, May 19 with “Neutral”. The firm earned “Market Perform” rating on Monday, August 15 by Telsey Advisory Group. The stock of American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) earned “Sell” rating by Morgan Stanley on Tuesday, August 25. On Friday, January 8 the stock rating was maintained by Mizuho with “Neutral”. The firm has “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets given on Tuesday, August 8. 
Contrarius Investment Management Ltd decreased Tegna Inc stake by 171,586 shares to 101,086 valued at $1.42M in 2017Q4. It also reduced Michael Kors Hldgs Ltd (NYSE:KORS) stake by 610,139 shares and now owns 92,188 shares. Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) was reduced too. 
Ratings analysis reveals 100% of MacQuarie Infrastructure’s analysts are positive. Out of 2 Wall Street analysts rating MacQuarie Infrastructure, 2 give it “Buy”, 0 “Sell” rating, while 0 recommend “Hold”. The lowest target is $89.0 while the high is $98.0. The stock’s average target of $93.50 is 141.54% above today’s ($38.71) share price. MIC was included in 2 notes of analysts from November 2, 2016. RBC Capital Markets maintained Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation (NYSE:MIC) rating on Wednesday, November 2. RBC Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $98.0 target. As per Thursday, February 23, the company rating was maintained by Barclays Capital. 
The stock decreased 1.28% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $38.71. About 930,670 shares traded. Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation (MIC) has declined 54.12% since April 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.67% the S&P500. 
Michael & Susan Dell Foundation holds 53.96% of its portfolio in Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation for 1.26 million shares. Tiger Legatus Capital Management Llc owns 700,000 shares or 17% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Moab Capital Partners Llc has 11.36% invested in the company for 702,199 shares. The New York-based Selz Capital Llc has invested 9.63% in the stock. Archer Capital Management L.P., a New York-based fund reported 310,741 shares. 
Analysts await Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation (NYSE:MIC) to report earnings on May, 2 after the close. They expect $0.61 EPS, up 38.64% or $0.17 from last year’s $0.44 per share. MIC’s profit will be $51.80 million for 15.86 P/E if the $0.61 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.59 actual EPS reported by Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 3.39% EPS growth. 
Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation, through its subsidiaries, owns and operates a portfolio of businesses that provide services to businesses, government agencies, and individuals. The company has market cap of $3.29 billion. It operates through four divisions: International-Matex Tank Terminals , Atlantic Aviation, Contracted Power (CP), and MIC Hawaii. It has a 7.55 P/E ratio. The IMTT segment offers bulk liquid storage, handling, and other services for petroleum products, chemicals, renewable fuels, and vegetable and animal oils at 10 marine terminals in the United States and 2 marine terminals in Canada.
